summary: The simulation is syntactically valid and generally comprehensive, but it contains a critical scheduling/dependency bug that prevents purchase requests from being fulfilled, and it omits several task-specified metrics/features. Main() is correctly called at global scope.

issues.description: RetailSupplyModule has no dependency on DecisionAndAdoptionModule, so it can execute before purchase requests are generated. As a result, purchase_requests are never processed during the same day and are lost when buffers reset, meaning agents never receive purchased masks.
issues.solution: Set RetailSupplyModule.dependencies = ["DecisionAndAdoptionModule"] to ensure supply runs after decisions, or adjust the scheduler/order accordingly.

issues.description: Several required metrics and outputs from the task spec are not implemented or only partially implemented: sustained_adoption_rate, adoption_by_group beyond income, adoption_disparity_index (a direct metric), masks_sold totals, and policy_effect_contribution (counterfactual effect of mandates).
issues.location: Metrics collection (Simulation.evaluate and results accumulation); RetailSupplyModule (no masks_sold tally); policy effect estimation not present
issues.solution: Add metrics: (1) sustained_adoption_rate as mean over final K days; (2) adoption_by_group stratified by age and income; (3) explicit adoption_disparity_index (e.g., Gini); (4) masks_sold counter tracked from allocations; (5) policy_effect_contribution via a counterfactual run with mandate_level=0 and comparing adoption.

issues.description: Risk perception updates are committed at end-of-day, so decisions at day t do not reflect MessagingAndRiskModule updates at day t even though the module depends on messaging. This may be intended (next-day effect) but is not explicit.
issues.location: MessagingAndRiskModule.forward and DecisionAndAdoptionModule.forward with state_updates committed in Simulation._commit_buffers
issues.solution: Either document that risk updates take effect next day or have DecisionAndAdoptionModule read risk updates from buffers (if present) for same-day decisions.

issues.description: Entity/parameter naming diverges from the provided schema (e.g., Location vs Venue, trust_authority vs trust_in_authorities, location_types). This does not break execution but diverges from the spec.
issues.solution: Harmonize names with the task spec or add a translation layer so the provided schema keys map to the internal names.

issues.description: Frequent bare or broad try/except blocks swallow exceptions without logging details, which can hide runtime issues.
issues.location: Various functions (e.g., seed_all, save_results, save_all_io, load_ground_truth, BasicParamsAdapter._load_param_defs, etc.)
issues.solution: Narrow exception types and log exception messages with context. Consider raising on critical failures.

issues.description: RandomSearchCalibrator may be somewhat heavy depending on environment, though it downscales N and T. There are minor redundant computations (e.g., repeated income tercile computation in DecisionAndAdoptionModule).
issues.solution: Cache repeated computations within a day (e.g., income terciles). Allow CLI to control calibration budget and optionally disable calibration in quick runs.
